implementation: Unconditional host hook retains per-source pending and unknown operation state across toolbar withdrawal, close/reopen and section visits; changing saved text alone does not clear unknown filing holds.

Deliberate toolbar action uses existing GovernedConfirmDialog and mutateVerbatim, dedicated reason, exact expected document/program/section/binding/saved timestamp and no content or authorship claims.
Current full metadata identity/project/native binding, section timestamp, document edit/seal state and synchronous canonical editor/session guards are checked before request.
Exact source receipt and canonical filingSectionKey relationship required; contradictory positive/uncertain failure envelopes stay held.
Receipt presentation and callbacks require the originating source/session/project/access visit. Assembly scope is described in the confirmation.
Ordinary Save, RichSectionEditor, generic mutationUnconfirmed, shared confirmation, company documents and Vault writers unchanged.
Contradiction scanning traverses nested arrays before plain objects, preserving the existing six-level depth bound and generic mutation classifier.
limits: Qualification uses real mounted editor/UI over synthetic HTTP plus a contained controller fixture. Native server/transaction tests and actual database contract are owned by server worker; parent owns build/full TypeScript/push gates.

Unknown filing/audit outcomes intentionally cannot be cleared by Authoring-only reads or ordinary dialog reopening in the mounted host. User must check current filing/audit records; this bounded change adds no reconciliation engine.

supersedes.reason: Independent review found a committed:true claim nested inside a refusal array bypassed contradiction scanning. Added one transport/controller regression, saw RED, then recursed arrays within the existing depth bound. Current primary56 replace prior55.
